amendment_statement: Run 001 was voided after native execution revealed a deterministic QUTest 0.1.0 parser incompatibility for rxx/rzz. No Stage-2 relations or diagnostic classifications were computed. The amendment introduces a uniform semantics-preserving execution adapter applied to every original and mutant; the frozen subject and mutant populations remain unchanged.

parser_support_matrix.measurement: direct gate-level probe of QUTest 0.1.0, not inferred from outcome counts

execution_adapter.scope: applied uniformly to all 9 originals and all 270 mutants; outside the mutation region

adapter_conformance.comparison: each circuit C against A(C) only; no original-versus-mutant comparison was made, and no R_S, R_O or CL relation was computed

guard_integrity_fix.defect: guard_smin counts only KILLED repetitions as false failures, so an all-UNSUPPORTED original scored zero and was reported ORIGINAL_GUARD_VALID
guard_integrity_fix.fix: execution-integrity wrapper: every repetition must have a supported status before the frozen guard criterion is applied
guard_integrity_fix.classification: technical correctness guard, not a new diagnostic rule
guard_integrity_fix.applied: symmetrically to all nine external originals before Run 002

population_preservation.mutation_identity: unchanged; the frozen pre-adapter mutant hash remains the mutant's identity, and the adapted form is only its executable serialization

fixed_input_subjects.subject: qft_n4
fixed_input_subjects.realized_input: x q[0]; x q[2] prefix inside the released circuit

unchanged_from_v3.contrast_pair_rule: For each arbitrary-input MgcosA subject, enumerate the computational-basis inputs under its frozen canonical parameterization and use the upstream classical reference / semantic mapping to identify inputs with distinct specified semantic effects. Order the basis inputs lexicographically. Select the lexicographically first pair (x_a, x_b) for which the specified operation acts differently on the two basis inputs in a way not reducible to one common global phase. Prepare |psi_in> = (|x_a> + |x_b>)/sqrt(2), a normalized zero-relative-phase superposition.
unchanged_from_v3.harness_side_preparation_rule: For arbitrary-input external subjects the realized input is part of the diagnostic context and is prepared by the execution harness before applying the frozen program P. Input-preparation gates are NOT part of P, are NOT mutation targets, and do NOT alter the frozen program or mutant definitions. This matches the diagnostic decomposition in which x and P are separate components of Gamma.

diagnostic_configuration.observation: joint computational-Z outcome distribution of the measured register

mutation_allocation.why: The external cohort is a prospective cohort; the prospective convention is the one packaged, runnable and deterministic. The construction convention's within-stratum ordering is not recoverable.
mutation_allocation.deduplication: by mutant_key / mutated_hash within the enumerated pool
mutation_allocation.apportionment: largest_remainder over available deduplicated sites; remainders by largest fraction then stratum order; shortfall redistributed by the same rule over remaining capacity

interpretation_frozen.if_cl3_observed: The observation-limitation mechanism also arose prospectively in external programs that were not used to construct or calibrate QSurvDiag.
interpretation_frozen.if_no_cl3: No supported CL3 case occurred in the prospective external cohort; independent prospective evidence for the mechanism therefore remains limited.
interpretation_frozen.in_either_case: The cohort is mechanism-oriented and does not estimate CL3 prevalence in quantum software.
